# Hernan Huwyler

> Official professional profile for Hernan Huwyler, an AI governance and enterprise risk leader, Academic Director, and Executive Professor.

Canonical profile: https://hwyler.github.io/

## About

Hernan Huwyler helps organizations turn complex AI opportunities and risks into practical decisions, controls, and measurable outcomes. He brings more than two decades of global experience across technology transformation, compliance, quantitative risk, internal audit, cybersecurity, predictive analytics, and applied artificial intelligence. He serves as an Academic Director and Executive Professor at IE Business School and IE Law School.

His work connects AI governance, quantitative risk modeling, and regulatory engineering. His professional focus includes the EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 23894, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.

## Blogs

  Practical writing on AI governance, AI risk, quantitative risk, compliance, security, procurement, controls, monitoring, and AI systems across their lifecycle.
